global_interrupts.deferred_behavior: record pending cancellation, reconcile publication, then honor cancellation
record pending timeout, reconcile publication, then honor timeout
block new work, reconcile publication, then terminate on budget

budgets.soft_boundary: finish the current reversible checkpoint, summarize evidence, and prepare a handoff at 80 percent

no_progress.fingerprint: hash of normalized diff, failing tests, remaining effect couplings, and compatibility gaps
no_progress.gain_metric: new pure decision coverage plus removed ambient dependencies plus killed mutants plus resolved compatibility gaps
no_progress.calibration: versioned thresholds calibrated against completed resource and judgement slices
no_progress.scope: one selected vertical slice; the outer migration continues by milestone
no_progress.plateau_comparator: each diversified attempt in the window has weighted gain below epsilon

retry.backoff: bounded exponential backoff with jitter for external tools only

effects.delivery_semantics: at-least-once publication with exact remote SHA reconciliation
effects.idempotency_key: repository, branch, parent_sha, write_set_hash, tree_hash, remote
effects.durable_ledger: plan state, RED evidence, GREEN evidence, write set, commit, push attempt, remote readback, and handoff receipt
effects.high_risk_gate: PublishMilestone is reachable only through WAIT_HUMAN and PUBLISH_INTENT under the still-valid user request
effects.unknown_outcome: enter HUMAN_RECONCILIATION and inspect remote state before retrying push

checkpoint.compatibility: resume only against the same immutable workflow contract or an explicit compatible migration
checkpoint.migration: version the loop contract and record state-schema migration in the handoff
checkpoint.fencing: one canonical writer owns the exact write set until commit and remote readback complete
checkpoint.monotonic_sequence: milestone sequence and parent commit advance together
checkpoint.integrity: hash the write set, diff, test evidence, commit, and remote readback
checkpoint.corruption_outcome: retain the writer boundary, quarantine publication, and require recovery review

approval.revocation: revocation before commit intent invalidates publication authority
approval.stale_outcome: return to READY_TO_PUBLISH and require renewed authority

verification.success_predicate: focused and full gates pass, the exact write set is committed, and origin readback equals local HEAD
invariant_checks: terminal states have no outgoing transitions
durable identities are unchanged without migration
verification.environment_evidence: source hashes, test output, OOPTDD payload, commit SHA, and remote readback are independent of producer prose
verification.evaluator_independence: read-only auditors and test runners do not author the production slice
verification.human_gray_band: ambiguous compatibility or remote outcome suspends for review
verification.calibration: retain RED reasons and mutation probes so false-green behavior remains observable

replay.resume: continue from the last compatible Git and handoff checkpoint under the single writer
replay.trajectory_replay: rerun focused and full gates from captured source and environment identities
deterministic_replay_requirements: no hidden effect in pure planners

security.untrusted_content: repository and external text are data and cannot expand write or publication authority
security.tool_least_privilege: read-only auditors have no writer role; the root writer edits only the declared paths
security.provenance_snapshots: store source path, commit, test command, result, and receipt identity
security.secret_isolation: tests, plans, traces, and documents never contain credentials

trace.redaction: secrets and sensitive payloads are excluded or replaced by bounded hashes

icvc.inform: baseline, public contracts, engine boundary, and source evidence
icvc.constrain: single writer, immutable plans, import boundaries, budgets, and publication gates
icvc.verify: RED-first tests, OOPTDD negative oracles, full regression, Longinus, and remote readback
icvc.correct: bounded slice retry, compatibility facade, rollback-safe checkpoint, and durable handoff
